current.text: He is a rookie center for OKC. He sits behind Isaiah Hartenstein, Chet Holmgren and Jaylin Williams in the center rotation, and Thomas Sorber also competes for big man minutes.
He has played well in preseason and is a hot name, with his ADP rising to 109.
Experts doubt he plays enough in the regular season to matter. One says he is not worth drafting in standard leagues. Another takes him only as a last-pick flyer because Holmgren is banged up.

durable.text: He is a huge center whose shot blocking is real.
He is a strong passer for a big man, and experts rate his FG% and passing as strengths.
His free throw shooting is very poor.
He plays drop coverage only and does not project as a switchable big. He lacks a go-to offensive move.
He makes almost no threes and gives very little in points and steals.

note: At Yahoo rank 243 with a 1 USD average cost (0.3 USD on ESPN), he is far outside our 144 drafted players. Do not pay more than 1 USD. His rising preseason ADP of 109 comes from hype, not from a regular-season role. Early in the season, track Chet Holmgren's health and OKC's center minutes. With a projected 5.1 points, 1.1 blocks, almost no threes and weak FT shooting, he only becomes a short-term blocks pickup if he wins real minutes.
